title: Kernel benchmark measurements
responsibility: Builds benchmark entries from measured values or explicit unavailability, including the source and artifact sizes recorded by a kernel build.

inputs.name: benchMeasurement.context
inputs.description: Machine profile and tested commit, or null when the run cannot be attributed to a clean revision.

inputs.name: benchMeasurement.entry
inputs.description: Target, metric, unit, method and either a numeric value or an unavailable reason; optionally workload, sample count and artifact identities.

inputs.name: sizeMeasurements.context
inputs.description: Machine profile and tested commit to attach to every size entry.

inputs.name: sizeMeasurements.build
inputs.description: Kernel build record containing Wasm and native artifact sizes and hashes, plus reference and crate source sizes and files.

outputs.name: kernelUnits
outputs.description: Maps module and HTTP targets to function.impact-kernel, and Wasm and process targets to kernel.impact-kernel.

outputs.name: benchMeasurement
outputs.description: Benchmark entry with the target owner, profile and revision; absent workload becomes null and absent artifacts become an empty array. An unavailable value becomes null with its reason.

outputs.name: sizeMeasurements
outputs.description: Seven byte measurements: unavailable module and HTTP artifact sizes, measured Wasm and process artifacts, and module, Wasm and process source sizes. Values come from the supplied build record.
